starting-off.speaker: Doric
starting-off.text: Hello traveller, what brings you to my humble smithy?

options.text: I wanted to use your anvils.

steps.player: I wanted to use your anvils.

steps.speaker: Doric
steps.text: My anvils get enough work with my own use. I make pickaxes, and it takes a lot of hard work. If you could get me some more materials, then I could let you use them.

steps.player: Yes, I will get you the materials.

steps.speaker: Doric
steps.text: Clay is what I use more than anything, to make casts. Could you get me 6 clay, 4 copper ore, and 2 iron ore, please? I could pay a little, and let you use my anvils. Take this pickaxe with you just in case you need it.
If the player does not already have all of the materials:
If the player already has all of the materials:

steps.player: You know, it's funny you should require those exact things!

steps.speaker: Doric
steps.text: What do you mean?

steps.player: I can usually fit 28 things in my backpack and in a world full of quite literally limitless possibilities, a complete coincidence has occurred!

steps.speaker: Doric
steps.text: I don't quite understand what you're saying?

steps.player: Well, out of pure coincidence, despite definitely not knowing what you were about to request, I just so happened to have carried those exact items!

steps.text: If the player has the exact amounts:

steps.player: In fact, in the exact quantities too!

steps.speaker: Doric
steps.text: Oh my, that is a coincidence! Pass them here, please. I can spare you some coins for your trouble, and please use my anvils any time you want.
You hand the clay, copper, and iron to Doric.
Quest complete!

steps.player: No, hitting rocks is for the boring people, sorry.

steps.speaker: Doric
steps.text: That is your choice. Nice to meet you anyway.

options.text: I want to use your whetstone.

steps.player: I wanted to use your whetstone.

steps.speaker: Doric
steps.text: The whetstone is for more advanced smithing, but I could let you use it as well as my anvils if you could get me some more materials.

steps.speaker: Doric
steps.text: How nice to meet someone with such pleasant manners. Do come again when you need to shout at someone smaller than you!

options.text: I was just checking out the landscape.

steps.player: I was just checking out the landscape.

steps.speaker: Doric
steps.text: Hope you like it. I do enjoy the solitude of my little home. If you get time, please say hi to my friends in the Dwarven Mine.

steps.speaker: Doric
steps.text: Yep, the entrance is in the side of Ice Mountain just to the east of here. They're a friendly bunch. Stop in at Nurmof's store and buy one of my pickaxes!

steps.speaker: Doric
steps.text: I make pickaxes. I am the best maker of pickaxes in the whole of Gielinor.

steps.player: Do you have any to sell?

steps.speaker: Doric
steps.text: Sorry, but I've got a running order with Nurmof.

steps.speaker: Doric
steps.text: Nurmof has a store over in the Dwarven Mine. You can find the entrance on the side of Ice Mountain to the east of here.

starting-off-attempting-to-use-his-anvil.speaker: Doric
starting-off-attempting-to-use-his-anvil.text: Hey, who said you could use that? My anvils get enough work with my own use. I make pickaxes, and it takes a lot of hard work.

options.text: Sorry, would it be OK if I used your anvils?

steps.player: Sorry, would it be OK if I used your anvils?

steps.speaker: Doric
steps.text: If you could get me some more materials then I could let you use them.

options.text: Yes, I will get you materials.
No, hitting rocks is for the boring people, sorry.
I didn't want to use your anvils anyway.

steps.player: I didn't want to use your anvils anyway.

steps.speaker: Doric
steps.text: That is your choice.

starting-off-attempting-to-use-his-whets.text: You should probably ask before using that.

starting-off-talking-to-doric-without-al.speaker: Doric
starting-off-talking-to-doric-without-al.text: Have you got my materials yet, traveller?

starting-off-talking-to-doric-without-al.player: Sorry, I don't have them all yet.

starting-off-talking-to-doric-without-al.speaker: Doric
starting-off-talking-to-doric-without-al.text: Not to worry, stick at it. Remember, I need 6 clay, 4 copper ore, and 2 iron ore.

starting-off-returning-with-all-the-mate.speaker: Doric
starting-off-returning-with-all-the-mate.text: Have you got my materials yet, traveller?

starting-off-returning-with-all-the-mate.speaker: Doric
starting-off-returning-with-all-the-mate.text: Many thanks! Pass them here, please. I can spare you some coins for your trouble, and please use my anvils any time you want.
You hand the clay, copper, and iron to Doric.
